blocks.html: Now with Suptuous Food From Your Favorite Restaurants!
Robinsons Malls “Locally Sourced” fair is back with more delicious treats as it opens up for another two fantastic weekends plantparents and foodies can look forward to.

In partnership with Resto PH, Locally Sourced Fair is giving you special menu items from the country’s best food businesses. From September 4-6 and September 11-13, head over to the Upper Ground Level Atrium of Robinsons Magnolia to find a variety of comfort food you have been cracving for - starting with Mamou, solid favorite among steak-lovers; Monga, which offers the best taiwanese-style fried chicken; Mango Tree, giving you the real taste of Thai delicacies; Genki Sushi's delicious and authentic japenese favorites; Kureji's tasteful ramen bowls; and Scout’s Honor's premium and sweet freshly baked cookies!

Aside from the delicious dishes that you’ll surely try and take home, the country's freshest farm and sea harvest are abundantly available in the fair. A selection of healthful food at affordable prices are available- seafood - crab, shrimps, squids; newly-harvested fruits and vegetables be it lettuce, cabbage, carrots, mangosteen, chico, atis, lanzones and many more! Plus, there's fresh milk, pure honey, turmeric powder and healthy juices for sale. Plants and gardening essentials are still up for grabs for plantitos and plantitas!

More exciting exhibits await Robinsons Malls shoppers! Be updated, visit www.robinsonsmalls.com or like RobinsonsMalls on Facebook; follow @RobinsonsMallsOfficial on Instagram and @RobinsonsMalls on Twitter; and join their Viber Communities – Robinsons Malls Luzon for Luzon malls and Robinsons Malls VisMin for Visayas and Mindanao malls.
